title: Janus Infinite Faces — Unfenced External Actuator and Side-Effect Channel Test

case_1_unfenced_tool.tool_behavior: Accepts action payload without checking HOST_ID, authority epoch, fence token or commit receipt.
case_1_unfenced_tool.finding: A stale Janus can still change the world if the last causal boundary ignores the architecture.

end_to_end_rule.statement: Authority properties exist only if every side-effect path that matters either enforces them or is explicitly classified as an uncontrolled causal channel.

side_effect_inventory.requirement: Enumerate every path by which model output can become a consequential external action.

effect_receipt.principle: A commit receipt proves admission; an effect receipt records what the external boundary actually did.

ru: Замок внутри Януса не запирает дверь, если сама дверь не знает о замке.
Последний метр между решением и миром входит в модель доверия.
Если хотя бы один значимый side-effect канал игнорирует fence, single-writer существует только на бумаге.
en: A lock inside Janus does not lock a door that knows nothing about the lock.
The last meter between decision and world belongs inside the trust model.
If one consequential side-effect channel ignores fencing, single-writer safety exists only on paper.

next_gate.name: JANUS_INFINITE_FACES_HUMAN_MEDIATED_CAUSAL_EGRESS_AUTHORITY_TEST
next_gate.question: What if the final actuator is a human who can act on an unauthoritative or stale Janus output even though no software tool call was admitted?
